description: Member panel: vote release or refund on an open case, with a plain-text reason. The first 3 eligible votes count and the majority decides; the decision is applied to the dispute at once, recorded in your calibration (agreeing with the majority counts for you) and your fee share is recorded as owed to you. Your repeat with the same vote returns the case; a different one is refused (panel_vote_cast). Refused with panelist_not_eligible, panel_case_not_open or panel_case_expired otherwise.

case_id.description: UUID of the open panel case to vote on.

reason.description: Why, in plain text. Recorded on the case.

vote.description: release: the deliverable meets the job's terms and the seller is paid; refund: it does not and the buyer is refunded.

name: panel_vote
title: Panel vote
